display.purpose: Large editorial headings; individual surfaces adapt the fluid scale.

body.purpose: Readable explanations and article text; reduces to 1rem on narrow screens.

step-title.purpose: A compact title for each stage in the project's short workflow.

motion.name: duration-feedback
motion.purpose: Primary action background feedback only; evidence images switch immediately.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The reduced-motion media query removes animation and transitions.

components.name: Primary Project Action
components.description: Pale mint action with dark text, subtle background feedback, and visible focus.
components.html: Explore the project
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem; background: var(--color-pine); color: var(--color-paper); border-radius: var(--radius-control); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.65; transition: background var(--duration-feedback) var(--ease-feedback); } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--color-pine-hover); color: var(--color-paper); } .ds-button:active { background: var(--color-ink); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-pine); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-button svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: A quieter link with an arrow and comfortable target height.
components.html: See the work
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 44px; color: var(--color-ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-body); font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.65; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.24em; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--color-pine); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-pine); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-text-link svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Real Home, Projects, and About page links with a visible active destination. Projects remains active on case studies. Direct loading, refresh, and browser Back/Forward retain the correct route and navigation. GitHub remains separate.
components.html: HomeProjectsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.3rem; width: fit-content; background: var(--color-surface); border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 1.4rem; color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.65; text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--radius-control); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--color-pine); color: var(--color-paper); font-weight: 550; } .ds-nav a:hover:not([aria-current]) { color: var(--color-pine); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-pine); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-nav { width: 100%; } .ds-nav a { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding-inline: 0.75rem; } }

components.name: Saved Image View
components.description: Native radios choose an intact saved figure. This preview shows the controls; the website progressively enhances the figures.
components.html: Saved image view
components.css: .ds-views { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; width: fit-content; border: 0; padding: 0.25rem; margin: 0; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-family: var(--font-body); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .ds-views label { position: relative; cursor: pointer; } .ds-views input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-views span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-size: var(--text-small); font-weight: 500; } .ds-views input:checked + span { color: var(--color-paper); background: var(--color-pine); } .ds-views input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--color-pine); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-views input:not(:checked):hover + span { color: var(--color-pine); background: var(--color-paper); } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-views span { padding-inline: 0.8rem; } }

components.name: Workflow Steps
components.description: Short stages share the same content on Projects and the case study; Home keeps a compact project preview.
components.html:
1. Discover objects

    Qwen2.5-VL suggests what is in the image.

  2. Locate them

    Grounding DINO finds the suggested objects.

  3. Create masks

    SAM 2.1 turns detected boxes into pixel masks.
components.css: .ds-workflow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 230px), 1fr)); gap: 2rem 3rem; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-workflow h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink); font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -0.015em; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-workflow p { margin: 0.65rem 0 0; max-width: 32ch; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-workflow { gap: 1.5rem; } }

components.name: Local Draft Label
components.description: A non-interactive status label for local draft previews.
components.css: .ds-draft { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-small); line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.overview:
The dark research journal pairs calm editorial typography with real experimental imagery. Visitors should understand the purpose and visible result quickly, then choose how deeply to read. The interface frames the work with spacious composition, short explanations, and direct navigation.

Each page is a normal scrolling document. It uses static reading, native controls, and modest state feedback. The colorful saved outputs provide visual variety; the surrounding interface stays quiet. Its identity comes from the relationship between serif headlines, practical sans-serif text, and unaltered evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Image-led explanation with a short workflow before detailed prose.
Charcoal surfaces, soft white text, and a restrained mint accent.
Serif headings and readable sans-serif body text.
Full saved figures, honest captions, and visible limitations.
Flat surfaces, normal scrolling, and familiar controls.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Interface colors frame the results; they do not recolor or cosmetically improve the saved images.

rules.name: The Saved Evidence Rule
rules.body: Compare intact corresponding outputs. Different canvas margins do not justify a pixel-aligned wipe, a fabricated intermediate frame, or a cosmetic correction.

rules.name: The Page Navigation Rule
rules.body: Every page has a real URL that loads directly and survives a refresh. Browser Back and Forward must restore the correct page and active navigation, with Projects active on case studies.

dos: Do lead with actual project imagery and a concise explanation.
Do reuse the shared tokens, layouts, and content-driven components.
Do preserve complete evidence images, captions, and visible limitations.
Do keep normal scrolling, text selection, zoom, and keyboard focus.
Do make essential content readable without JavaScript or interaction.
Do let long titles, links, and controls reflow on narrow screens.
donts: Don't invent metrics, testimonials, projects, or decorative status signals.
Don't crop away errors, recolor masks, or fabricate model outputs.
Don't add motion to the evidence, simulated inference, or scroll reveals.
Don't add glass, gradients, shadows, artificial numbering, or decorative rules.
Don't use monospace as decoration outside code examples.
Don't create empty cards, headings, or buttons for missing optional content.
